premises.text: College students struggle to find help and resources for studying
premises.evidence_span: it's really hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand. It's hard to find study groups.

premises.text: The most connected generation struggles to get help from classmates
premises.evidence_span: the most connected and social generation ever could not get help from the people they see every day in class.

premises.text: A platform can connect students for collaborative learning
premises.evidence_span: any student can easily access the brain power and knowledge of their entire class right on our platform.

premises.text: Students can create and share collaborative study guides
premises.evidence_span: one of his classmates created in one tap a collaborative study guide for everyone to help by adding their answers.

premises.text: Students can access shared resources from previous semesters
premises.evidence_span: the students even like the fact that they can have access to files from previous semesters.

premises.text: A peer mentor program can provide scalable, on-demand tutoring
premises.evidence_span: we decided to make it highly scalable, affordable, and highly targeted.

premises.text: Students can earn money by becoming peer mentors
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow every single college student to offer online on-demand tutoring sessions and make some money while helping others.

premises.text: The platform can target students' specific needs for help
premises.evidence_span: we know exactly when they need help. We know exactly the subject they need help with.

value.text: Students receive personalized, on-demand help to improve their academic performance
value.evidence_span: a way for every single college student to get personalized one-on-one help right when they need it.

notes: Corporate customer count, fundraising, and demo offer excluded as traction.
